Asparagus Or Spinach Lasagna
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 11, 2009 - 11:35pm

Ingredients




5 lasagna noodles
2 cloves minced garlic
1/2 teaspoon crushed thyme
2 tablespoons butter
2 tablespoons flour
 cups milk
1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
1 cup julienne ham
1 can asparagus or spinach, (15 oz.)

Preparation

1 Cook noodles as directed on package, drain and cut in half. In saucepan cook garlic and thyme in butter. Blend in flour; cook stirring constantly until thick. Season to taste with salt and pepper. In microwaveable dish layer 1/3 noodles, sauce, cheese, ham and asparagus or spinach. Repeat layers 2 more times. In microwave cover and cook on high 9-10 minutes. Rotate dish twice. 4 servings
